decisions.quote: Also, in the present study, it is important to consider that the small sample size of the discovery sample could have an impact upon the power to capture more subtle genetic association effects. Finally, we cannot exclude the possibility that genes not validated/replicated for leprosy per se susceptibility are actually controlling susceptibility to endophenotype of the disease, such as clinical forms and the occurrence of reversal reactions.
decisions.reason: The study tested five non-HLA candidate genes across four loci (CCDC122-LACC1, NOD2, TNFSF15, and RIPK2) from the original Chinese GWAS (Zhang et al., 2009), replicating the associations at NOD2 and CCDC122-LACC1 while failing to validate TNFSF15 and RIPK2, so the replication outcome is mixed rather than successful.
